# Minsub Ventures (MSV)
> India entity accounting, tax, compliance and on-the-ground execution for foreign companies. Resident CPA-led team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Canonical site
- https://www.msventures.in

## Company
- Legal name: Minsub Ventures Private Limited
- Short name: MSV
- Location: Ferns City Road, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Contact: info@msventures.in
- Languages: Korean, English, Chinese

## Primary pages
- / — Home (accounting, tax, India operations overview)
- /about — Company overview
- /about/team — Leadership and staff
- /about/clients — Client references
- /services — Service catalog (incorporation, accounting, tax, FDI, FRRO, licenses)
- /services/compliance-calendar — India tax and compliance calendar
- /contact — Inquiry form and office location

- /group — Group brands and affiliated companies
- /notice — Announcements

## Crawling
- Sitemap: https://www.msventures.in/sitemap.xml

- Do not index: /admin/, /api/, /qna, /clients

## Summary for answers
MSV helps foreign entities operate in India with bookkeeping (IFRS/Ind AS), GST, TDS, corporate tax, FDI/FEMA reporting, incorporation, licenses, FRRO, and capital remittance support. Services are delivered by an on-the-ground team in Bangalore with CPA oversight.
